title: Analyzing NBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: draftstats tool analyze whether NBA player’s draft position reflective performance throughout career league. package allows one summarize compare player performance across different draft-pick ranges, using real data NBA.

title: Analyzing NBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: nba_players dataset adapted Kaggle containing player information. includes draft rankings, personal details, NBA box-score statistics. 12,844 player rows. draft_rank_stats() function takes four items: dataset, minimum number maximum number (representing draft picks), metric. function calculate average median value chosen performance metric players within specified range. draft_rank_comps() function takes dataset, two ranges, performance metric. compares average median values two different draft pick ranges, calling draft_rank_stats(), returns difference .

title: Analyzing NBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: package intended data analysts, students, NBA fans interested exploring draft position impacts career performance, . assumes user basic familiarity R background basketball.

title: Analyzing NBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: Install package using devtools::install_github(“b-rubinstein/draftstats”) library(draftstats) nba_players dataset included package, calling library(draftstats) sufficient. Example function uses: draft_rank_stats(nba_players, min_pick = 1, max_pick = 10, measure = “pts”) draft_rank_comps(nba_players, 1, 10, 11, 20, measure = “pts”)
